source:
"As pessoas podem esquecer das coisas importantes, mas elas voltam rastejando em nossos sonhos."
Tente desafiar os Inimigos especiais atrás da porta. Boa sorte.
target:
"People may forget the important things, but they will crawl back in our dreams."
Try challenging the special enemy behind the door. Good luck.

source:
"Eles flutuam... e você também vai flutuar."
Ajude Dorothy a derrotar o monstro atrás da porta.
target:
"They float... and you'll float too."
Help Dorothy defeat the monster behind the door.

source:
"Justo quando você pensa que acabou, na verdade só está começando."
Tente enfrentar o inimigo especial atrás da porta. Boa sorte.
target:
"Just when you think it's over, it's only just begun."
Try challenging the special enemy behind the door. Good luck.

source:
"Mesmo no abismo mais profundo, algo belo pode nascer."
Ajude Dorothy a derrotar o monstro atrás da porta.
target:
"Even in the deepest abyss, something beautiful can be born."
Help Dorothy defeat the monster behind the door.

source:
"Não, ele fez uma promessa à morte que não cumpriu."
Ajude Dorothy a derrotar o monstro atrás da porta.
target:
"No, he made a promise to death that he didn't keep."
Help Dorothy defeat the monster behind the door.

source:
"O ritual pode falhar, mas talvez afaste algo pior - o medo."
Tente desafiar o Inimigo especial atrás da porta. Boa sorte.
target:
"The ritual may fail, but it might drive away something worse—fear."
Try challenging the special enemy behind the door. Good luck.

source:
"Três, quatro, é melhor trancar sua porta..."
Tente desafiar os Inimigos especiais atrás da porta. Boa sorte.
target:
"Three, four, better lock your door..."
Try challenging the special enemy behind the door. Good luck.

source:
"Um, dois, ele está vindo atrás de você..."
Ajude Dorothy a derrotar o monstro atrás da porta.
target:
"One, two, it's coming for you..."
Help Dorothy defeat the monster behind the door.

source:
"Você acha que está gritando, mas na verdade isso é..."
Tente enfrentar os Inimigos especiais atrás da porta. Boa sorte.
target:
"You think you're screaming, but that's actually..."
Try challenging the special enemy behind the door. Good luck.

source:
"Você faz um desejo, e ele se torna seu... No final, tudo que é seu voltará para você."
Ajude Dorothy a derrotar o monstro atrás da porta.
target:
"You make a wish, and it becomes yours... In the end, everything that’s yours will come back to you."
Help Dorothy defeat the monster behind the door.

source: "การจะเป็นขุนนางที่แท้จริงไม่ใช่แค่ถือปืน แต่ต้องมีวิสัยทัศน์ด้วย"
target: "To be a true noble, it's not enough to have a gun. You must have vision."

source:
"การผจญภัยที่ยิ่งใหญ่ในเรื่องราว มักจะเริ่มต้นด้วยลมพายุที่พัดมาจากที่ไหนก็ไม่รู้"
ช่วย Dorothy เอาชนะมอนสเตอร์ที่อยู่หลังประตู
target:
"Great adventures in stories have a way of starting off with a sudden gust of wind out of nowhere."
Help Dorothy defeat the monsters behind the gate.

source:
"ความกล้าหาญเป็นเพียงสินค้าสิ้นเปลืองอย่างหนึ่ง และจะแพงขึ้นเมื่อเราอายุมากขึ้น"
ช่วย Dorothy เอาชนะมอนสเตอร์ที่อยู่หลังประตู
target:
"Courage is just a consumable by nature, it gets more expensive as you get older."
Help Dorothy defeat the monsters behind the gate.

source: "ความเจ็บปวดที่ทวีคูณจะเยียวยาหัวใจ พอถอนหายใจลึกๆ แล้ว คุณก็ได้กำเนิดใหม่อีกครั้ง"
target: "Ramping pain mends the heart. With a heavy sigh, you are reborn."

source:
"คุณขอพร แล้วมันก็จะกลายเป็นของคุณ... ในท้ายที่สุด ทุกสิ่งที่เป็นของคุณจะกลับคืนมาหาคุณเอง"
ช่วย Dorothy เอาชนะมอนสเตอร์ที่อยู่หลังประตู
target:
"You make a wish, and it becomes yours... In the end, everything that’s yours will come back to you."
Help Dorothy defeat the monster behind the door.

source:
"คุณคิดว่าคุณกำลังกรีดร้อง แต่จริงๆ แล้วนั่นคือ..."
ลองท้าทายศัตรูพิเศษที่อยู่หลังประตู โชคดีนะ
target:
"You think you're screaming, but that's actually..."
Try challenging the special enemy behind the door. Good luck.

source: "คุณตระหนักว่าสุดท้ายแล้วทุกสิ่งทุกอย่างจะเลือนหายไปตามกาลเวลา เหมือนหยดน้ำตาที่อันตรธานไปในสายฝน"
target: "You realize that everything will eventually fade away in time. Just like a drop of tear disappearing in the rain."

source:
"คุณไม่เชื่อแน่ว่าพวกเขาใส่อะไรบนพิซซ่าแทนซอสมะเขือเทศ..."
"อะไรเหรอ?"
"มายองเนส!"
"แหวะ นั่นมันอาหารนอกรีตชัดๆ !"
target:
"You won't believe what they put on their pizza instead of tomato sauce..."
"What?"
"Mayonnaise!"
"Ugh, that's heresy!"

source:
"ฉันแค่กำลังซ้อมเล่าความจริงเกี่ยวกับเทพนิยายเหล่านั้นให้คุณได้รู้"
ช่วย Dorothy เอาชนะมอนสเตอร์ที่อยู่หลังประตู
target:
"I'm just practicing how to tell you the truth about those fairy tales."
Help Dorothy defeat the monsters behind the gate.

source:
"ถึงเวลาต้องกล่าวลาแล้ว ฉันจะทิ้งตัวตนที่อ่อนแอในอดีตไว้ที่นี่"
ช่วย Dorothy เอาชนะมอนสเตอร์ที่อยู่หลังประตู
target:
"The time to say goodbye has come. This is where I will leave behind my weak self of the past."
Help Dorothy defeat the monsters behind the gate.

source: "ทำไมชาว Montelli ถึงชื่อ 'ลีโอนาโด' กันเยอะจัง? หรือว่ามีธรรมเนียมการตั้งชื่อที่ฉันพลาดไป?"
target: "What's with all the Montellis named 'Leonardo'? Is there a naming convention I missed?"

source:
"ผู้คนอาจจะลืมสิ่งสำคัญ แต่สิ่งเหล่านั้นจะคืบคลานกลับมาในความฝันของเรา"
ลองท้าทายศัตรูพิเศษที่อยู่หลังประตู โชคดีนะ
target:
"People may forget the important things, but they will crawl back in our dreams."
Try challenging the special enemy behind the door. Good luck.

source: "ผู้ที่แบกรับนามทั้งปวงไว้จะมุ่งหน้าสู่วันพรุ่งนี้"
target: "The person bearing all names heads off into tomorrow."

source:
"พระอาทิตย์ขึ้นเหนือหมู่บ้าน พรุ่งนี้จะเป็นวันใหม่ที่สดใสหรือเปล่านะ?"
ช่วย Dorothy เอาชนะมอนสเตอร์ที่อยู่หลังประตู
target:
"The sun rises over the village houses. I wonder if tomorrow will be a brand new day?"
Help Dorothy defeat the monsters behind the gate.

source:
"พวกมันลอยได้... และคุณก็จะลอยได้เช่นกัน"
ช่วย Dorothy เอาชนะมอนสเตอร์ที่อยู่หลังประตู
target:
"They float... and you'll float too."
Help Dorothy defeat the monster behind the door.

source: "พวกเขาชอบเรื่องราวที่คุณเขียน แต่โลกไม่ได้ใจดีเหมือนในเรื่องราวพวกนั้นหรอก"
target: "They enjoy the stories you wrote. But the world is not as kind as the stories describe."

source:
"พิธีกรรมอาจล้มเหลว แต่มันอาจจะขับไล่สิ่งที่แย่กว่านั้นไป...ความกลัว"
ลองท้าทายศัตรูพิเศษที่อยู่หลังประตู โชคดีนะ
target:
"The ritual may fail, but it might drive away something worse—fear."
Try challenging the special enemy behind the door. Good luck.

source: "พ่อค้าชั้นเลวขายสินค้า แต่พ่อค้าชั้นดีขายความฝัน"
target: "A mediocre merchant sells products. An ace merchant sells dreams."

source:
"สาม สี่ ล็อกประตูให้ดี..."
ลองท้าทายศัตรูพิเศษที่อยู่หลังประตู โชคดีนะ
target:
"Three, four, better lock your door..."
Try challenging the special enemy behind the door. Good luck.

source:
"หนึ่ง สอง มันกำลังมาหาเธอ..."
ช่วย Dorothy เอาชนะมอนสเตอร์ที่อยู่หลังประตู
target:
"One, two, it's coming for you..."
Help Dorothy defeat the monster behind the door.

source:
"ออกเดินทางตามล่าความฝัน ขอให้คุณได้พบกับตัวตนที่แท้จริงในโลกที่ชัดเจนยิ่งขึ้นแห่งนี้"
ช่วย Dorothy เอาชนะมอนสเตอร์ที่อยู่หลังประตู
target:
"Embark on a dream-seeking journey. May you find your true self in this clearer world."
Help Dorothy defeat the monsters behind the gate.

source: "อะไรคือสิ่งที่รบกวนใจคุณที่สุดเกี่ยวกับรากูนน่า?"
target: "What is the one thing that bothers you most about Ragunna?"

source: "อากาศ" อัดขวด
"เราอยู่เหนือโชคชะตา เราต่างหากที่กำหนดว่าใครจะมีชีวิตที่สุขสบาย และใครต้องเผชิญชะตาอันโหดร้าย"
target: "We're better than fate. We decide who lives the good life, and who faces a harsher hand."

source: "แม้ตระกูล Fisalia และตระกูล Montelli อาจจะสั่นคลอน แต่ภาคีจะไม่ล่มสลาย"
target: "The Fisalias and the Montellis may falter, but the Order cannot."

source:
"แม้ในห้วงลึกที่สุด สิ่งที่งดงามก็สามารถถือกำเนิดขึ้นมาได้"
ช่วย Dorothy เอาชนะมอนสเตอร์ที่อยู่หลังประตู
target:
"Even in the deepest abyss, something beautiful can be born."
Help Dorothy defeat the monster behind the door.

source: "โลกนี้คือแดนรกร้างอันกว้างใหญ่ และคุณเป็นดั่งรถไฟที่เชื่อมโยงคนแต่ละรุ่นเข้าด้วยกัน"
target: "The world is a vast wasteland, and you are a train connecting generations."

source:
"ในตอนที่คุณคิดว่ามันจบลงแล้ว แต่มันเพิ่งจะเริ่มต้นขึ้นเท่านั้น"
ลองท้าทายศัตรูพิเศษที่อยู่หลังประตู โชคดีนะ
target:
"Just when you think it's over, it's only just begun."
Try challenging the special enemy behind the door. Good luck.

source:
"ไม่ เขาสัญญากับความตายเอาไว้ แต่เขากลับไม่รักษาสัญญา"
ช่วย Dorothy เอาชนะมอนสเตอร์ที่อยู่หลังประตู
target:
"No, he made a promise to death that he didn't keep."
Help Dorothy defeat the monster behind the door.

target: Deal 7,000,000 Fusion Burst or Glacio Chafe DMG to enemies in a single battle

5성 공명자가 제외된 파티를 사용하여 단일 전투에서 특이점 확장 3500pt 획득

A Redução da Força de Vibração recebida pelo Sigillum é reduzida em 20%.
target: The Vibration Strength Reduction taken by Sigillum is reduced by 20%.

source: A Redução da Força de Vibração sofrida pela Prisão de Miríades: Corpo Decadente diminui em 20%.
target: Vibration Strength Reduction taken by Myriad Snare: Rustfire Chassis is reduced by 20%.

source: A Taxa de Redução da Força de Vibração contra Aix Lamentoso diminui em 15%. Contra-ATQs restauram 10 pontos de Energia de Ressonância ao atingir e adicionalmente reduzem a Força de Vibração do alvo em 30% do seu máximo.
target: The Vibration Strength Reduction Rate against Mourning Aix is reduced by 15%. Counterattacks restore 10 points of Resonance Energy on hit and additionally reduces the Vibration Strength of the target by 30% of its maximum.

source: A Taxa de Redução da Força de Vibração de Fleurdelys é reduzida em 15%. Contra-ataques de Desvio reduzem a Força de Vibração do alvo em 15% do Máximo, com recarga de 6s.
target: Fleurdelys's Vibration Strength Reduction Rate is decreased by 15%. Dodge Counters reduce the target's Vibration Strength by 15% of the Max, cooldown 6s.

source: A Taxa de Redução de Força de Vibração de Fleurdelys é reduzida em 30%.
target: Fleurdelys's Vibration Strength Reduction Rate is now decreased by 30%.

source: A busca por partidas só pode ser feita pelo anfitrião no modo cooperativo multijogador
target: Matchmaking can only be done by the host in multiplayer Co-op

source: A cópia distorcida da pintura criou um reino de ilusão através do Poder de Ressonância da artista. Suas emoções negativas profundamente enraizadas corroeram suas cores e trouxeram à vida poderosas Dissonâncias Transgressoras.
target: The distorted copy of the painting has created a realm of illusion through the artist's Forte. Her deeply rooted negative emotions have corroded its colors and brought powerful Tacet Discords to life.

source: A cúpula está despedaçada, e a luz que resta ilumina ruínas cobertas pela vegetação. Entre a densa vegetação, a Propulsão do Reator moribunda preserva apenas uma vaga lembrança de quando foi o sol.
target: The dome is shattered, and what light remains illuminates overgrown ruins. Amidst thick weeds, the dying Reactor Drive holds onto a mere memory that it once was the sun.

source: A espada consegue sentir sua própria forma.
target: The sword can sense its own form.

source: A floresta balança, abrindo caminho para a luz que espreita. Em algum lugar no silêncio, as criaturas se agitam.
target: The forest sways, making way for the peeking light. Somewhere in the quietness, the beasts stir.

source: A fé que guia o povo

A fúria da Divindade desce mais uma vez, espalhando Seu evangelho da perdição como marés rastejantes.
Mais uma vez, a esperança transcende o medo e as sombras para iluminar a noite eterna.
target:
The Divinity’s fury descends once again, spreading Its gospel of doom like creeping tides.
Once more, hope transcends fear and shadows to illuminate the eternal night.

source: A luz solar brilha sobre a neve, irradiando o calor da primavera.
target: Sunlight gleams over the snow, radiating the warmth of spring.

source:
A medida que el tiempo se ralentiza, las ondas de luz se estiran, tal vez ahí reside la respuesta última al universo.
Por favor, protege el dispositivo experimental y ayuda a Cosmos a completar la prueba.
target:
As time slows down, the light waves are stretched out—perhaps therein lies the ultimate answer to the universe.
Please protect the experimental device and help Cosmos complete the test.

source:
A medida que las olas rompen en la distancia, los sirvientes del Ovatrax emergen de las costas, galopando en la tempestad.

El Sandbox Infinito proyecta una Esfera Sonora repleta de peligros. Avanza con cautela.
target:
As waves crash in the distance, servants of the Ovathrax emerge from the coasts, galloping in the tempest.

The Infinite Reality Sandbox projects a Sonoro Sphere fraught with danger. Proceed with caution.

source:
A música persiste e a cortina carmesim se levanta mais uma vez.
Você dançará novamente com ela neste drama interminável?
target:
The music persists, and the crimson curtain rises once more.
Will you dance again with her in this endless drama?

source: A sombra iminente do passado preparou as suas armas, aguardando um desafiante. É hora de as chamas da guerra se extinguirem.
target: The looming shadow of the past has readied its weapons, awaiting a challenger. It is time for the flames of war to extinguish.

source: ATK ของ Mourning Aix จะเพิ่มขึ้น 6% ทุก 5 วินาที สามารถเพิ่มได้สูงสุด 72% เมื่อเข้าสู่สถานะอัมพาต จะล้างจำนวนชั้นทั้งหมด และหยุดการซ้อนทับ
target: Mourning Aix's ATK is increased by 6% every 5s, up to 72%. Immobilizing it clears all stacks and pauses stacking.

source: ATK ของ Reactor Husk เพิ่มขึ้น 20% หลังจากได้รับความเสียหายจากเอฟเฟกต์ดีบัฟแล้ว จะสลับเอฟเฟกต์นี้เป็นลด ATK ลง 20%
target: Reactor Husk's ATK is increased by 20%. After taking Negative Status DMG, Reactor Husk's ATK is decreased by 20% instead.

source: ATK ของ Reactor Husk เพิ่มขึ้น 25% อย่างถาวร
target: Reactor Husk's ATK is permanently increased by 25%.

source: ATK ของ Sentry Construct จะเพิ่มขึ้น 3% ทุก 5 วินาที สามารถซ้อนทับได้สูงสุด 10 ชั้น เมื่อเข้าสู่สถานะอัมพาต จะล้างจำนวนชั้นทั้งหมด และหยุดการซ้อนทับ
target: Sentry Construct's ATK is increased by 3% every 5s, stacking up to 10 times. Immobilizing it clears all stacks and pauses the stacking of this effect for the duration of Immobilization.

source: ATK ของ Tempest Mephis จะเพิ่มขึ้น 30% เมื่อ Tempest Mephis มีเสียงบีบกด: เบี่ยงเบนหรือเสียงบีบกด: ก่อกวน โบนัสนี้จะไม่เกิดผล
target: Tempest Mephis's ATK is increased by 30%. This effect is disabled when it is affected by Tune Strain - Shifting or Tune Strain - Interfered.

source: ATK ของ Thundering Mephis จะเพิ่มขึ้น 3% ทุก 5 วินาที สามารถซ้อนทับได้สูงสุด 10 ชั้น เมื่อเข้าสู่สถานะอัมพาต จะล้างจำนวนชั้นทั้งหมด และหยุดการซ้อนทับ
target: Thundering Mephis's ATK is increased by 3% every 5s, stacking up to 10 times. Immobilizing it clears all stacks and pauses the stacking.

source: ATK ของศัตรูเพิ่มขึ้น 50% ความเสียหายฮาวอคสุดท้ายที่ศัตรูได้รับเพิ่มขึ้น 10% เมื่อได้รับผลกระทบจากเอฟเฟกต์ฮาวอคทำลายล้าง เอฟเฟกต์นี้จะเพิ่มขึ้นเป็น 40%

source: Dans la Tourbe piaulante, il existe une porte mystérieuse qui vous permet d'accéder à un espace intéressant : le Somnoire. On dit que les rêves de tous les êtres de Solaris se rassemblent là-bas...
target: A mysterious gateway emerges in the Whining Aix's Mire, providing access to a realm known as Somnoire. Legend has it that it hosts the dreams of all beings in Solaris.

source: Dans le Somnoire, une flamme noire brûle. Au bord du rêve, vous avez vu « quelqu'un ». Son ambition de brûler le monde ne disparaît jamais - même dans le rêve.
target: Dark flames dance in the Somnoire. This time, near the edge of dreams, you glimpse a familiar figure… At least here in your dreams, his ambition to engulf the world in flames shall forever burn.

source: Dans les berceaux d'un bleu profond, les nénuphars ondulent, leurs pétales portant le poids des rêves nés du pinceau du peintre.
target: In the cradles of deep blue, the water lilies sway, their petals carrying the weight of dreams that flow from the painter's touch.

source: Dans les profondeurs de cette trame onirique, comment trouver le fil du tisseur ?
target: Deep within this web of dreams, where will you find the weaver's thread?

source: Dans une terre inhabitée où le temps s'écoule de manière turbulente, des plumes de flamme montrent le chemin sur un échiquier où les étoiles sont les pièces de jeu. Ici, l'élu tend la main et touche le passé lointain sous les flammes.
target: In an uninhabited land where time flows turbulently, feathers of flame guide the way on a chessboard where the stars are the playing pieces. Here, the destined one reaches out and touches the distant past under the flames.

target: Sentry Construct's ATK is increased by 3% every 5s, stacking up to 10 times. Immobilizing it clears all stacks and pauses the stacking of this effect for the duration of Immobilization.

source: Der ANG von Donnernder Mephis erhöht sich alle 5 Sek. um 3 %, bis zu 10-fach stapelbar. Wird er immobilisiert, werden alle Stapel entfernt und das Stapeln pausiert.
target: Thundering Mephis's ATK is increased by 3% every 5s, stacking up to 10 times. Immobilizing it clears all stacks and pauses the stacking.

source: Der ANG von Gegnern wird um 50 % erhöht. Feinde erleiden 10 % mehr finalen Chaos-Schaden, oder 40 %, wenn sie unter dem Chaosfluch stehen.
target: Enemy ATK is increased by 50%. Enemies take 10% more total Havoc DMG, or 40% when affected by Havoc Bane.

source: Der ANG von Sturm Mephis wird um 30 % erhöht. Dieser Bonus wird entfernt, wenn er von Klanglast: Verschiebung oder Klanglast: Störung betroffen ist.
target: Tempest Mephis's ATK is increased by 30%. This effect is disabled when it is affected by Tune Strain - Shifting or Tune Strain - Interfered.

source: Der ANG von Trauernder Aix erhöht sich alle 5 s um 6 %, bis zu 72 %. Bei Immobilisierung werden alle Stapel entfernt und können nicht gestapelt werden.
target: Mourning Aix's ATK is increased by 6% every 5s, up to 72%. Immobilizing it clears all stacks and pauses stacking.

source: Der Berg und die sechs Kredite
Der Druck in einem Level beeinflusst, wie belohnend ihr Erfolg sich anfühlt ... Aha, verstanden!
target: The tougher the level, the sweeter the win. Aha!

source: Der Gegenangriff eines Resonators erhöht beim Treffer die Verstimmungspunkte des Ziels um 20 % seines Maximums und verringert seine Vibrationsstärke um 30 % ihres Maximums.

source: Der Kreis schließt sich. Das Ergebnis scheint besiegelt.
target: The circle tightens. The outcome seems decided.

source: Der Strom der Überreste spiegelte die sternbeleuchteten Träume wider. Während die verstorbenen Phantome des Sommers die vergessenen Ruhmestage widerhallen.
target: The stream of remnant reflected the star-lit dreams. While the deceased phantoms of the summer reverberating the forgotten glories.

source: Der Vogel, der sich nach Freiheit sehnt, fiel in den Dornenbusch. Seine Federn leuchteten wie Flammen, sein Gesang strahlte wie die Sonne.
target: The bird yearning for freedom fallen to the thornbush. Its feathers lit like flame, song shine like sun.

source: Der Wald wiegt sich, macht dem lauernden Licht Platz. Irgendwo in der Stille regen sich die Bestien.
target: The forest sways, making way for the peeking light. Somewhere in the quietness, the beasts stir.

„Hier sind wir noch in den Oberflächenstufen, miau! Gib dein Bestes, miau!“

Carved in white stone are the names of heroes, every echo a remnant of former glory. Sleep now, brave ones, here in the dream, alongside this guardian of honor.

Desde el mundo al revés, vislumbras la verdad de la profecía.
Así comienza a girar la rueda del destino, mientras rompes la eterna mentira que cuelga del cielo, avanzando hacia tu batalla final.
target:
From the world upside down, you glimpse the truth of the prophecy.
Thus, the wheel of fate begins to turn, as you tear through the endless lie hanging from the sky, charging toward your "final battle."

source: Desolate Apparition - ฝันตื้น
Desolate Apparition - ฝันลึก

Die Akolythin mit Perlenschmuck an den Ohren blickt ewiglich zum Maler außerhalb des Bilderrahmens, ohne etwas sagen zu können.
„Sollte die goldene Jugend mir vergeblich eine Rose schenken?“
target:
Adorned with pearl earrings, the acolyte on the canvas casts her eternal gaze upon the painter, her silence echoing.
"Was it my golden youth that vainly gave me the roses?"

source: Die Bio-Mechas versuchten, die „Weisheit“, die in ihren Datenbanken gespeichert war, an andere Kreaturen weiterzugeben, aber ein gegenseitiges Verständnis war niemals möglich.
target: The biomechs attempted to pass the "wisdom" stored in their databases on to other creatures, but mutual understanding was never possible.

source: Die Erinnerungen und Fixierungen des Geistes dienen als Futter und schaffen eine trügerische Fassade, die an die Vergangenheit erinnert. Der innere Pfad ist tückisch, und jeder Fehltritt kann einen in einen bodenlosen Abgrund stürzen.
target: The mind's recollections and fixations serve as fodder, creating a deceiving facade reminiscent of the past. The internal path is treacherous, with any misstep potentially plunging one into a bottomless pit.

source: Die Fabrik war ein weitläufiger Komplex, der der Produktion einer Armee von unheimlichen Puppen gewidmet war. Aber inmitten des Chaos der fehlfunktionierenden Exilanten lauerten auch zahlreiche tödliche Fallen an jeder Ecke.
target:
This factory is a maze of malfunctioning Exiles and treacherous traps. Its sole purpose: to mass produce chilling puppets.
Treacherous traps lay in wait at every turn.

source:
Die Fisalia kennen die Herkunft des Imperators nicht. Doch in ihren Träumen steht er über allem.
„Er lässt das Meereswasser die Ufer überschwemmen und blickt auf die Ödländer und Gebirge.“
target:
The Fisalias do not know of Sentinel Imperator's origins, but in their dreams, there is no higher authority.
"Silent above the wastelands and the mountains, They command the sea to dash upon the cliffs."

source: Die Flut umkehren (Redewendung); die Wende herbeiführen

Die Glut ist noch nicht erloschen, aber die Erinnerungen bleiben.
Wenn du diesen Ort erneut betrittst, hallt die Katastrophe nach und die Erinnerungen an den Kampf mit den „Klingen“ kommen zurück zu dir.
target:
The embers have not yet been extinguished, but the memories remain.
When you re-enter this place, the disaster resonates and the memories of the fight with the "blades" come back to you.

source: Die Herausforderungsdaten der Ebenen 1–2 vom Turm des Nachhalls & Echo-Turm wurden für diesen Zyklus übernommen.
target: Floors 1-2 of Echoing Tower and Resonant Tower have been cleared with synced records.

source: Die Herausforderungsdaten der Ebenen 1–3 vom Turm des Nachhalls & Echo-Turm wurden für diesen Zyklus übernommen.
target: Floors 1-3 of Echoing Tower and Resonant Tower have been cleared with synced records.

source: Die Kuppel ist zerschmettert, und das verbleibende Licht erleuchtet überwucherte Ruinen. Mitten im dichten Unkraut hält der sterbende Reaktorantrieb an einer blassen Erinnerung fest, dass er einst die Sonne war.
target: The dome is shattered, and what light remains illuminates overgrown ruins. Amidst thick weeds, the dying Reactor Drive holds onto a mere memory that it once was the sun.

source: Die Musiker spielten in perfekter Synchronisation, ihre Instrumente verschmolzen zu einer kraftvollen und bewegenden Melodie.
target: The musicians played in perfect synchronization, their instruments blending together to create a powerful and moving melody.

source:
Die Phantome verweilen in der Wildnis, schleichen voran, während sie ihre Köpfe zu den heiseren Flüstern neigen.

Die Aqua-Sandbox projiziert eine Sonoro-Sphäre voller Gefahren. Geh vorsichtig vor.
target:
The phantoms linger in the wilderness, creeping ahead as they tilt their heads toward the husky whispers.

The Infinite Reality Sandbox projects a Sonoro Sphere fraught with danger. Proceed with caution.

source: Die Reduktionsrate der Vibrationsstärke von Trauernder Aix wird um 15 % verringert. Gegenangriffe stellen 10 Resonanzenergie wieder her und verringern bei Treffern die Vibrationsstärke des Ziels um 30 %.
target: The Vibration Strength Reduction Rate against Mourning Aix is reduced by 15%. Counterattacks restore 10 points of Resonance Energy on hit and additionally reduces the Vibration Strength of the target by 30% of its maximum.

source: Die Sonne ist zu einem düsteren und trüben Stern gefallen. Sie wird alles verschlingen, was noch übrig ist, sogar das schwächste Licht.
target: The sun has fallen to a dim and dismal star. It will devour all that remains, even the faintest light.

source: Die Sterne und der Mond hängen hoch am Himmel, glänzen unaufhörlich im dunklen Blau, als ob sie still auf das Fest unten antworten.
target: The stars and moon hang high in the sky, gleaming relentlessly against the deep blue, as if silently responding to the festivity below.

source: Die Verringerung der Vibrationsstärke der Myriadenfalle: Zerbrochenes Gerüst wird um 20 % reduziert.
target: Vibration Strength Reduction taken by Myriad Snare: Rustfire Chassis is reduced by 20%.

source: Die Zeit rinnt im Stundenglas... Finden wir die Antwort, bevor das letzte Sandkorn fällt?
target: Time trickles down in the hourglass… Can we find the answer before the last grain falls?

source: Die anderen Levels sind noch nicht fertig … Naja, lass uns dieses erstmal einfach halten!
target: Uh-oh, level shortage! Lemme throw one together real quick!

source: Die im kalten Becken lauernde Schildkröte schläft, während sie eine alte Glocke auf ihrem Rücken trägt. Wenn sie erwacht, hallt ihr langgezogener Glockenschlag oft durch die Geisterschluchten.
target: Large Mutant Organism that inhabits the depths of the Gorges of Spirits, the ancient bell on their backs can explode with extremely lethal sound waves when they are rung.

source: Die reine Kraft, die aus zwei extremen Konflikten hervorbricht.
target: The pure power bursting from two extreme conflictions.

source: Die verzerrte Kopie des Gemäldes hat durch die Stärke des Künstlers eine Illusionswelt erschaffen. Ihre tief verwurzelten negativen Emotionen haben die Farben korrodiert und mächtige Tacet-Dissonanzen zum Leben erweckt.
target: The distorted copy of the painting has created a realm of illusion through the artist's Forte. Her deeply rooted negative emotions have corroded its colors and brought powerful Tacet Discords to life.

source: Die vorgefertigten Resonatoren übernehmen die Resonanzketten-Knoten deiner eigenen Resonatoren.
target: The Demo Resonators will inherit the Resonance Chain nodes from your own Resonators.

source: Dies ist das Zeitalter der Maschinen, und ein großartiges noch dazu.
target: This is an age of machines, and a great one at that.

source: Diese Sonoro-Sphäre, in der die Grenze von Tag und Nacht klar existiert. In ihren Tiefen findest du Nebenprodukte des Waveworns, die sowohl Resonatoren als auch Waffen verstärken können.
target: Within the Sonoro Sphere, a beautiful forest that exists at the border of day and night, hides Character and Weapon Enhancement Items imbued with the Waveworn effect.

source: Diese alten unterirdischen Wasserwege sind nun zu Verstecken von Gangstern geworden. Wage dich mit Zani hinein, um das Übel auszumerzen, das sich dort eingenistet hat.
target: These ancient underground waterways have become gang hideouts. Join Zani in venturing inside to uproot the crime that's spread here.

Do mundo de cabeça para baixo, você vislumbra a verdade da profecia.

source: Ein vor langer Zeit versiegeltes, verborgenes Reich, einst die Wohnstätte eines gewissen Unterweltwandlers.
target: A hidden realm sealed away long ago, once the dwelling place of a certain Nethermancer.

source:
Eine andere Welt, verborgen in der Dunklen Flut. Aus ihren Tiefen hallen die Flüstern der uralten „Göttlichkeit“, Ursprung allen Übels und aller Furcht.
Diese Welt erwartet jeden, der es wagt, sie zu betreten.
target:
Another world concealed within the Dark Tide. From its depths resound the whispers of the ancient "Divinity," the origin of all malice and fear.
That world awaits all who dare to enter.

source: Eine anmutige Pose nützt in der Jagd wenig … aber wenn du darauf bestehst …
target: A splendid pose is of no use in a hunt, but if you insist...

source: Eine finstere Höhle, die sich am Ausgang des Labyrinths befindet und die Quelle des Nebels ist. In der tiefen Dunkelheit streifen bizarre Schatten mit furchterregendem Heulen …
target: At the end of the labyrinth lies a bizarre cave, seemingly the source of the mist. In the pitch darkness, twisted shadows flicker, accompanied by low, unsettling growls...

source: Eine geheime Studierendenwerkstatt in der Akademie.
target: A secret student base inside the academy.

source: Eine riesige Autopuppe, die die Strukturen des Tadelhofs absorbiert hat. Im Kampf gegen sie spürt man, dass sie offenbar von einer Art Besessenheit gebunden ist ...
target: A giant Autopuppet that has absorbed structures of Censure Courts. The strong obsessions that bind it can be felt by those who confront it.

source: Einige Forscher glauben, dass Bio-Mecha in der Lage sind, „Kunst“ zu schätzen. Die meisten jedoch bestehen darauf, dass es nicht mehr ist als eine algorithmische Halluzination.
target: Some researchers believe biomechs are capable of appreciating "art." Most, however, insist that it is nothing more than algorithmic hallucination.

source: Einige mögen alles als falsch abtun, aber die wirklich Weisen können die Wahrheit sogar in der Täuschung erkennen. Dieses Konzept erstreckt sich auch auf das virtuelle Training.
target: Some may dismiss all as false, but the truly wise can discern truth even in deception. This concept extends to virtual training as well.

target: Time trickles down in the hourglass… Can we find the answer before the last grain falls?

source:
Ele ainda sonha com as estrelas respondendo ao seu olhar, sem saber que além da borda do sonho, uma escuridão mais profunda o observa.
"Esta ainda é a Camada Superficial da Sonúmia, miau! Boa sorte!"
target:
It still dreams of the stars answering its gaze, unaware that past the edge of the dream, a deeper darkness watches.
"This is still the Surface Layer of the Somnoire, meow! Good luck!"

source: Eles me convidariam pra cerimônia, né? Hihi...

source:

“Louvado seja o Imperator!”

"Praise be to Imperator!"

source: Em uma terra desabitada onde o tempo flui turbulento, penas de chama guiam o caminho num tabuleiro de xadrez onde as estrelas são as peças do jogo. Aqui, o destinado estende a mão e toca o passado distante sob as chamas.

source:
En la ausencia del Carnevale, sueños melancólicos e inquietos vagaban por la noche estrellada de Raguna.
«Noche estrellada, pinta tu paleta de azul y gris».
target:
In the absence of the Carnevale, restless dreams drift through Ragunna's starry night.
"Starry, starry night. Paint your palette blue and gray."

source: En la forma, hay un significado inherente, una unidad armoniosa. Dentro de los gráficos yace la verdad de las reglas y las dimensiones.

source:
En la roca pálida reposan, grabados, los nombres de los héroes, ecos de la gloria de antaño. ¡Oh, descansad en paz, valientes! ¡Junto a vosotros está quien protege vuestra gloria!
«Seguimos en la superficie del paisaje onírico, ¡ánimo, miau!».
target:
Carved in white stone are the names of heroes, every echo a remnant of former glory. Sleep now, brave ones, here in the dream, alongside this guardian of honor.
"This is still the Surface Layer of the Somnoire, meow! Good luck!"

source: En las cunas del azul profundo, los nenúfares se mecen, sus pétalos cargando el peso de los sueños que fluyen del toque del pintor.

source: En lo profundo de esta red onírica, ¿dónde estará el hilo del tejedor?

source:
En los ojos del peregrino, el mar turbulento es la más pura representación de la virtud y la pasión.
«Intenta imaginar algo que nunca has visto y deja que tu mano recorra el lienzo».

"Try to imagine something you've never seen and let your hand flow across the canvas."

target: A realm where the flow of time is chaotic, and dawn and dusk intertwine. It embodies both the origin and the culmination of the order of time.

source:
La acólita de la perla fija su mirada en el pintor fuera del lienzo, como si quisiera decir algo, pero se queda en silencio.
«¿Acaso esa juventud dorada me regaló rosas en vano?»
target:
Adorned with pearl earrings, the acolyte on the canvas casts her eternal gaze upon the painter, her silence echoing.
"Was it my golden youth that vainly gave me the roses?"

source: La aniquilación no es dispersión, sino la creación de melodías continuas a partir de las notas más tenues.
target: Annihilation is not to disperse, but the creation of continuous melodies from the faintest notes.

source: La contradiction profonde jaillit la puissance suprême.
target: The pure power bursting from two extreme conflictions.

source: La copia distorsionada de la pintura ha creado un reino de ilusión a través del talento de la artista. Sus emociones negativas profundamente arraigadas han corroído sus colores y dado vida a potentes DT.
target: The distorted copy of the painting has created a realm of illusion through the artist's Forte. Her deeply rooted negative emotions have corroded its colors and brought powerful Tacet Discords to life.

source: La copie déformée de la peinture a créé un royaume d'illusion par le Forte de l'artiste. Ses émotions négatives profondément enracinées ont corrodé ses couleurs et ont donné vie à de puissants Tacet Discord.
target: The distorted copy of the painting has created a realm of illusion through the artist's Forte. Her deeply rooted negative emotions have corroded its colors and brought powerful Tacet Discords to life.

source: La corriente de remanente reflejó los sueños iluminados por las estrellas. Mientras los fantasmas fallecidos del verano reverberan las glorias olvidadas.
target: The stream of remnant reflected the star-lit dreams. While the deceased phantoms of the summer reverberating the forgotten glories.

source: La cúpula está rota, por lo que la luz remanente ilumina ruinas cubiertas de maleza. Entre las densas hierbas, un moribundo Motor Reactor apenas recuerda la luz del sol.
target: The dome is shattered, and what light remains illuminates overgrown ruins. Amidst thick weeds, the dying Reactor Drive holds onto a mere memory that it once was the sun.

source: La difficulté d'un niveau rend la réussite plus gratifiante... Eurêka !
target: The tougher the level, the sweeter the win. Aha!

source: La espada puede percibir su propia forma.
target: The sword can sense its own form.

source: La forme elle-même signifie quelue chose : la vérité est cachée dans les règles et les mesures.
target: In the form, there is inherent meaning, a harmonious unity. Within the graphics lies the truth of rules and dimensions.

source: La forêt ondule, laissant filtrer la lumière. Dans le silence, les bêtes s'agitent.
target: The forest sways, making way for the peeking light. Somewhere in the quietness, the beasts stir.

source:
La fureur de la Divinité tombe de nouveau, répandant son hymne de destruction telle une marée rampante.
Une fois de plus, l'espoir traverse la peur et les ombres pour illuminer la nuit éternelle.
target:
The Divinity’s fury descends once again, spreading Its gospel of doom like creeping tides.
Once more, hope transcends fear and shadows to illuminate the eternal night.

source:
La furia de la divinidad se abate de nuevo, y el evangelio del fin se extiende como una marea.
Una vez más, atraviesa todos los miedos y sombras; con esta esperanza, quema la noche eterna.
target:
The Divinity’s fury descends once again, spreading Its gospel of doom like creeping tides.
Once more, hope transcends fear and shadows to illuminate the eternal night.

source: La fábrica era un complejo en expansión, dedicado a producir un ejército de espeluznantes marionetas. Pero en medio del caos de los Exiliados en mal funcionamiento, también había numerosas trampas mortales acechando en cada esquina.
target:
This factory is a maze of malfunctioning Exiles and treacherous traps. Its sole purpose: to mass produce chilling puppets.
Treacherous traps lay in wait at every turn.

source:
La guerra engendra más guerra, y el dolor genera más sufrimiento. En la quietud del sueño, las semillas de la malicia echan raíces.

source: La lumière se disperse parmi les arbres, laissant naître des ombres. Ces taches de clarté sont-elles les visages des arbres, ou des habits cousus par l'aurore ?
target: Shadows and light lie scattered amongst the trees. The patches of light, are they faces of the trees, or garments tailored by the dawn?

source: La luz del sol brilla sobre la nieve, irradiando la calidez de la primavera.
target: Sunlight gleams over the snow, radiating the warmth of spring.

source: La mer de nuages scintille sous les derniers rayons du jour. La gondole jaillit de l'eau, sa courbe dans les airs semblant attraper le soleil couchant.
target: The Sea of Clouds shimmers under the last rays of daylight. The Gondola leaps from the water, its curve in the air appearing to catch the setting sun.

source:
La musique sonne encore et le rideau écarlate se lève à nouveau.
Dansez encore une fois avec elle dans ce long spectacle.

The music persists, and the crimson curtain rises once more.
Will you dance again with her in this endless drama?

En este largo drama, baila una vez más con ella.

Le feu persiste, les souvenirs demeurent.

target:
The embers have not yet been extinguished, but the memories remain.
When you re-enter this place, the disaster resonates and the memories of the fight with the "blades" come back to you.

source: Le flot de vestiges reflétait les rêves étoilés. Tandis que les fantômes défunts de l'été réverbèrent les gloires oubliées.
target: The stream of remnant reflected the star-lit dreams. While the deceased phantoms of the summer reverberating the forgotten glories.

source:
Le passé est le futur du présent, ce qui a été fait hier va déterminer le demain.
Il faut les renvoyer dans les profondeurs du rêve.
target:
Yesterday lives on beyond tomorrow. What you've done will shape the world that's yet to come.
It must return to the Abyss of Dreams.

source: Le premier niveau est généralement un tutoriel, non ?

source: Le prédateur et la proie se rencontrent d'une manière inattendue.

source: Le soleil scintille sur la neige, diffusant la chaleur du printemps.

source:
Les fantômes restent dans la nature, avançant en inclinant la tête vers les murmures rauques.

La simulation de mégadonnées projette une Sonora remplie de dangers. Avancez avec prudence.
target:
The phantoms linger in the wilderness, creeping ahead as they tilt their heads toward the husky whispers.

The Infinite Reality Sandbox projects a Sonoro Sphere fraught with danger. Proceed with caution.

source:
Les fréquences anormales se rassemblent dans le Somnoire, la forme qu'elles prennent semble familière...
Il faut les renvoyer dans les profondeurs du rêve.
target:
Strange frequencies boil in the Somnoire, slowly taking shape into something familiar.
It must return to the Abyss of Dreams.

source: Les fréquences sont très différentes, mais elles peuvent se mélanger les unes aux autres pour créer une mélodie de combat imprévisible.
target: Combine various frequencies, ensemble of the melodies of battle.

source: Les nœuds de Chaîne résonatrice du personnage de démo seront activés en fonction de ceux de votre personnage.
target: The Demo Resonators will inherit the Resonance Chain nodes from your own Resonators.

source: Les souvenirs et les obsessions du passé créent des illusions : un mirage du passé. Tout est imprévisible. Faites attention : il est possible que vous tombiez dans l'abîme.
target: The mind's recollections and fixations serve as fodder, creating a deceiving facade reminiscent of the past. The internal path is treacherous, with any misstep potentially plunging one into a bottomless pit.

source: Les traces parlent le langage de la proie, nous menant droit à elle.
target: Tracks speak the prey's language. They lead us straight to them.

source: Les vaguelettes scintillent en dansant, alors que les mots tombent dans le silence.
target: A quiet stream flows between us… Words fade, but feelings remain.

source:
Les vagues de la mer agitée, vues par les yeux d'un pèlerin, étaient remplies de passion et de sentiments grandioses.
« Imaginez. Donnez forme à ce que vous n'avez jamais vu. »
target:
Through the pilgrim's eyes, the turbulent sea is the very embodiment of virtue and passion.
"Try to imagine something you've never seen and let your hand flow across the canvas."

source: Les égouts abandonnés sont devenus le territoire des gangs les plus dangereux. Plongez dans ce dédale souterrain aux côtés de Zani pour nettoyer ces bas-fonds de la corruption.
target: These ancient underground waterways have become gang hideouts. Join Zani in venturing inside to uproot the crime that's spread here.

source: Les étoiles et la lune brillent haut dans le ciel, étincelant sans relâche sur le bleu profond, comme si elles répondaient en silence aux festivités d'en bas.
target: The stars and moon hang high in the sky, gleaming relentlessly against the deep blue, as if silently responding to the festivity below.

Reduce Echo Skill Cooldown. Echo Skill inflicts a Stagnation effect on the enemy and marks it. Every marked enemy takes extra DMG.

source: Llamas oscuras danzan en Somnolencia. En lo profundo de tu sueño, vislumbras una figura familiar; aquí, en el sueño, su ardiente ambición de envolver el mundo en fuego permanece intacta.
target: Dark flames dance in the Somnoire. This time, near the edge of dreams, you glimpse a familiar figure… At least here in your dreams, his ambition to engulf the world in flames shall forever burn.

source: Localizada no ponto zero do Lamento, dentro do poço profundo. Parece que não há fim para o seu começo. Apenas o gemido escuro responde a qualquer pioneiro, essa é a reverberação do Lamento.
target: Located in the zero point of the Lament, inside the deep well. It seems there's no end to its beginning. Only the dark moaning would reply to any pioneer, that's the reverberation of Lament.
